title: Growth config: EXPERIMENT_POLICY
description: Experiment guardrails (GRW-P3-A): run length, SRM alpha, concurrency, k-anonymity. First-party funnel facts only; no health surface, no money surface. Added in 1.13.0. PROPOSED_DEFAULT until ratified. Unknown keys rejected.

srmAlpha.description: p-value under which results are hidden. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 0.001.

kAnonymity.description: Smallest cell a result may show; never below 10.

maxRunFactor.description: An experiment short of its sample at this multiple of its planned days is stopped

guardrailMinEvents.description: Events in the treatment arm before a guardrail breach can be declared

conversionWindowDays.description: Conversions are attributed within this many days after exposure

maxCookieExperiments.description: Experiments a single visitor key may be in

deniedTags.description: Surface tags that may never be experimented on (health, price, fees)
